messages:
Ellen: dropping a new 'timeline snapshot' mock 12 compact row that shows version, tiny traffic indicator, and an inline restore affordance. quick eyes on copy + keyboard flows? figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/timeline-snapshot (page: snapshot-v1) Ravi: nice density. main ask: make the restore CTA less scary. prefer 'Switch to vX' or 'Restore vX' vs 'Rollback'. Sonia: +1 to 'Restore vX'. also suggest inline undo toast for 20s. modal only if change >=25% traffic or multi-region. Ben: implementation note: when traffic <3% show dot + percent; 3-20% micro-bar; >20% full mini-bar. helps visual weight. Also virtualization needed once >300 entries. A11yBot: automated scan: contrast fail on light teal pill at 12px. recommend darker teal or 1px stroke. Also ensure restore button has aria-label 'Restore version v2.1.0'. Ellen: noted. keyboard flows: Tab to row, Enter expands details, M opens menu, Shift+R triggers restore shortcut (with confirm). Thoughts? Ravi: prefer Ctrl/Cmd modifiers to avoid accidental triggers. maybe Shift+R is safer cross-browser. document shortcut in help. Sonia: accessibility nit: modal must trap focus and include aria-live polite updates for progress. example snippet: ```

Restore version v2.1.0?

Routing: 100% to v2.1.0
``` Ben: perf note: expanded details should be overlayed not inserted inline to avoid reflow when virtualization is active. keep focused item mounted. Ellen: ok action list: 1) change copy to 'Restore vX' 2) add inline undo toast 20s rule 3) darken badges for contrast 4) write shortcut doc (Shift+R default) 5) overlay for expanded details + virtualization spike. DeployBot: ticket created RED-3702: "Timeline snapshot: restore copy, undo toast, contrast fixes, virtualization" https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/RED-3702 :white_check_mark: Ellen: thanks all 44f i'll update the figma and the spec and ping when done.
